transliteration: Taa-Seeen-Meeem

translations.en.sahih: Ta, Seen, Meem.
translations.en.pickthall: Ta. Sin. Mim.
translations.en.yusufali: Ta. Sin. Mim.
translations.id.indonesian: Thaa Siim Miim

transliteration: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen

translations.en.sahih: These are the verses of the clear Book.
translations.en.pickthall: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
translations.en.yusufali: These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah ayat-ayat Al Quran yang menerangkan.

arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
translations.en.pickthall: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
translations.en.yusufali: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
translations.id.indonesian: Boleh jadi kamu (Muhammad) akan membinasakan dirimu, karena mereka tidak beriman.

arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
transliteration: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een

translations.en.sahih: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
translations.en.pickthall: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
translations.en.yusufali: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
translations.id.indonesian: Jika kami kehendaki niscaya Kami menurunkan kepada mereka mukjizat dari langit, maka senantiasa kuduk-kuduk mereka tunduk kepadanya.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen

translations.en.sahih: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
translations.en.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
translations.en.yusufali: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sekali-kali tidak datang kepada mereka suatu peringatan baru dari Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, melainkan mereka selalu berpaling daripadanya.

arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
transliteration: Faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

translations.en.sahih: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
translations.en.pickthall: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
translations.en.yusufali: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at!
translations.id.indonesian: Sungguh mereka telah mendustakan (Al Quran), maka kelak akan datang kepada mereka (kenyataan dari) berita-berita yang selalu mereka perolok-olokkan.

arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
transliteration: Awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem

translations.en.sahih: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
translations.en.pickthall: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?
translations.en.yusufali: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan bumi, berapakah banyaknya Kami tumbuhkan di bumi itu pelbagai macam tumbuh-tumbuhan yang baik?

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Inn fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat suatu tanda kekuasaan Allah. Dan kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
translations.en.pickthall: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (ingatlah) ketika Tuhanmu menyeru Musa (dengan firman-Nya): "Datangilah kaum yang zalim itu,

transliteration: Qawma Fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon

translations.en.sahih: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
translations.en.pickthall: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?
translations.en.yusufali: "The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah?"
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) kaum Fir'aun. Mengapa mereka tidak bertakwa?"

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood:
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya aku takut bahwa mereka akan mendustakan aku.

arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
transliteration: Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa Haaroon

translations.en.sahih: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
translations.en.pickthall: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
translations.en.yusufali: "My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan (karenanya) sempitlah dadaku dan tidak lancar lidahku maka utuslah (Jibril) kepada Harun.

arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
transliteration: Wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon

translations.en.sahih: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
translations.en.pickthall: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
translations.en.yusufali: "And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku berdosa terhadap mereka, maka aku takut mereka akan membunuhku".

arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
transliteration: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
translations.en.yusufali: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call).
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Jangan takut (mereka tidak akan dapat membunuhmu), maka pergilah kamu berdua dengan membawa ayat-ayat Kami (mukjizat-mukjizat); sesungguhnya Kami bersamamu mendengarkan (apa-apa yang mereka katakan),

arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
translations.en.pickthall: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
translations.en.yusufali: "So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds;
translations.id.indonesian: Maka datanglah kamu berdua kepada Fir'aun dan katakanlah olehmu: "Sesungguhnya Kami adalah Rasul Tuhan semesta alam,

transliteration: An arsil ma'anaa Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.en.sahih: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
translations.en.pickthall: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.
translations.en.yusufali: "'Send thou with us the Children of Israel.'"
translations.id.indonesian: lepaskanlah Bani Israil (pergi) beserta kami".

arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
transliteration: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life?
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun menjawab: "Bukankah kami telah mengasuhmu di antara (keluarga) kami, waktu kamu masih kanak-kanak dan kamu tinggal bersama kami beberapa tahun dari umurmu.

arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
transliteration: Wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen

translations.en.sahih: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
translations.en.pickthall: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
translations.en.yusufali: "And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)!"
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu telah berbuat suatu perbuatan yang telah kamu lakukan itu dan kamu termasuk golongan orang-orang yang tidak membalas guna.

arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
transliteration: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
translations.en.yusufali: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error.
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Musa: "Aku telah melakukannya, sedang aku di waktu itu termasuk orang-orang yang khilaf.

arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen

translations.en.sahih: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
translations.en.pickthall: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
translations.en.yusufali: "So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu aku lari meninggalkan kamu ketika aku takut kepadamu, kemudian Tuhanku memberikan kepadaku ilmu serta Dia menjadikanku salah seorang di antara rasul-rasul.

arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
transliteration: Wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.en.sahih: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
translations.en.pickthall: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
translations.en.yusufali: "And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel!"
translations.id.indonesian: Budi yang kamu limpahkan kepadaku itu adalah (disebabkan) kamu telah memperbudak Bani Israil".

transliteration: Qaala Fir'awnu wa maa Rabbul 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
translations.en.pickthall: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
translations.en.yusufali: Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds'?"
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun bertanya: "Siapa Tuhan semesta alam itu?"

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
translations.en.pickthall: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure."
translations.id.indonesian: Musa menjawab: "Tuhan Pencipta langit dan bumi dan apa-apa yang di antara keduanya (Itulah Tuhanmu), jika kamu sekalian (orang-orang) mempercayai-Nya".

transliteration: Qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Fir'aun kepada orang-orang sekelilingnya: "Apakah kamu tidak mendengarkan?"

transliteration: Qaala Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning!"
translations.id.indonesian: Musa berkata (pula): "Tuhan kamu dan Tuhan nenek-nenek moyang kamu yang dahulu".

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
transliteration: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "Truly your messenger who has been sent to you is a veritable madman!"
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun berkata: "Sesungguhnya Rasulmu yang diutus kepada kamu sekalian benar-benar orang gila".

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "Lord of the East and the West, and all between! if ye only had sense!"
translations.id.indonesian: Musa berkata: "Tuhan yang menguasai timur dan barat dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya: (Itulah Tuhanmu) jika kamu mempergunakan akal".

arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
transliteration: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "If thou dost put forward any god other than me, I will certainly put thee in prison!"
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun berkata: "Sungguh jika kamu menyembah Tuhan selain aku, benar-benar aku akan menjadikan kamu salah seorang yang dipenjarakan".

transliteration: Qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "Even if I showed you something clear (and) convincing?"
translations.id.indonesian: Musa berkata: "Dan apakah (kamu akan melakukan itu) kendatipun aku tunjukkan kepadamu sesuatu (keterangan) yang nyata?"

arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "Show it then, if thou tellest the truth!"
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun berkata: "Datangkanlah sesuatu (keterangan) yang nyata itu, jika kamu adalah termasuk orang-orang yang benar".

arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
translations.en.pickthall: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,
translations.en.yusufali: So (Moses) threw his rod, and behold, it was a serpent, plain (for all to see)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Musa melemparkan tongkatnya, lalu tiba-tiba tongkat itu (menjadi) ular yang nyata.

arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
transliteration: Wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen

translations.en.sahih: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
translations.en.pickthall: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.
translations.en.yusufali: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan ia menarik tangannya (dari dalam bajunya), maka tiba-tiba tangan itu jadi putih (bersinar) bagi orang-orang yang melihatnya.

arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
transliteration: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
translations.en.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs around him: "This is indeed a sorcerer well-versed:
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun berkata kepada pembesar-pembesar yang berada sekelilingnya: Sesungguhnya Musa ini benar-benar seorang ahli sihir yang pandai,

arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
transliteration: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon

translations.en.sahih: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
translations.en.pickthall: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?
translations.en.yusufali: "His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel?"
translations.id.indonesian: ia hendak mengusir kamu dari negerimu sendiri dengan sihirnya; maka karena itu apakah yang kamu anjurkan?"

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
transliteration: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect-
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Tundalah (urusan) dia dan saudaranya dan kirimkanlah ke seluruh negeri orang-orang yang akan mengumpulkan (ahli sihir),

transliteration: Yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem

translations.en.sahih: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
translations.en.pickthall: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.
translations.en.yusufali: "And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed."
translations.id.indonesian: niscaya mereka akan mendatangkan semua ahli sihir yang pandai kepadamu".

transliteration: Fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati Yawmim ma'loom

translations.en.sahih: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
translations.en.pickthall: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
translations.en.yusufali: So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu dikumpulkan ahli-ahli sihir pada waktu yang ditetapkan di hari yang maklum,

transliteration: Wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon

translations.en.sahih: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
translations.en.pickthall: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?
translations.en.yusufali: And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled?-
translations.id.indonesian: dan dikatakan kepada orang banyak: "Berkumpullah kamu sekalian.

arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
transliteration: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen

translations.en.sahih: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
translations.en.pickthall: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
translations.en.yusufali: "That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win?"
translations.id.indonesian: semoga kita mengikuti ahli-ahli sihir jika mereka adalah orang-orang yang menang"

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
transliteration: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen

translations.en.sahih: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
translations.en.pickthall: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?
translations.en.yusufali: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh: "Of course - shall we have a (suitable) reward if we win?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tatkala ahli-ahli sihir datang, merekapun bertanya kepada Fir'aun: "Apakah kami sungguh-sungguh mendapat upah yang besar jika kami adalah orang-orang yang menang?"

arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
transliteration: Qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Yea, (and more),- for ye shall in that case be (raised to posts) nearest (to my person)."
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun menjawab: "Ya, kalau demikian, sesungguhnya kamu sekalian benar-benar akan menjadi orang yang didekatkan (kepadaku)".

arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
transliteration: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon

translations.en.sahih: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
translations.en.pickthall: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!
translations.en.yusufali: Moses said to them: "Throw ye - that which ye are about to throw!"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkatalah Musa kepada mereka: "Lemparkanlah apa yang hendak kamu lemparkan".

arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
transliteration: Fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon

translations.en.sahih: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
translations.en.pickthall: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.
translations.en.yusufali: So they threw their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the might of Pharaoh, it is we who will certainly win!"
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu mereka melemparkan tali temali dan tongkat-tongkat mereka dan berkata: "Demi kekuasaan Fir'aun, sesungguhnya kami benar-benar akan menang".

arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
transliteration: Fa alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon

translations.en.sahih: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
translations.en.pickthall: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.
translations.en.yusufali: Then Moses threw his rod, when, behold, it straightway swallows up all the falsehoods which they fake!
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Musa menjatuhkan tongkatnya maka tiba-tiba ia menelan benda-benda palsu yang mereka ada-adakan itu.

transliteration: Fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen

translations.en.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: And the wizards were flung prostrate,
translations.en.yusufali: Then did the sorcerers fall down, prostrate in adoration,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tersungkurlah ahli-ahli sihir sambil bersujud (kepada Allah),

transliteration: Qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
translations.en.pickthall: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
translations.en.yusufali: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
translations.id.indonesian: mereka berkata: "Kami beriman kepada Tuhan semesta alam,

transliteration: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon

translations.en.sahih: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
translations.en.pickthall: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.
translations.en.yusufali: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) Tuhan Musa dan Harun".

arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
transliteration: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
translations.en.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.
translations.en.yusufali: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross!"
translations.id.indonesian: Fir'aun berkata: "Apakah kamu sekalian beriman kepada Musa sebelum aku memberi izin kepadamu? Sesungguhnya dia benar-benar pemimpinmu yang mengajarkan sihir kepadamu maka kamu nanti pasti benar-benar akan mengetahui (akibat perbuatanmu); sesungguhnya aku akan memotong tanganmu dan kakimu dengan bersilangan dan aku akan menyalibmu semuanya".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
translations.en.pickthall: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "No matter! for us, we shall but return to our Lord!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Tidak ada kemudharatan (bagi kami); sesungguhnya kami akan kembali kepada Tuhan kami,

arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.
translations.en.yusufali: "Only, our desire is that our Lord will forgive us our faults, that we may become foremost among the believers!"
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya kami amat menginginkan bahwa Tuhan kami akan mengampuni kesalahan kami, karena kami adalah orang-orang yang pertama-tama beriman".

arabic: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
transliteration: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon

translations.en.sahih: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
translations.en.pickthall: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.
translations.en.yusufali: By inspiration we told Moses: "Travel by night with my servants; for surely ye shall be pursued."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami wahyukan (perintahkan) kepada Musa: "Pergilah di malam hari dengan membawa hamba-hamba-Ku (Bani Israil), karena sesungguhnya kamu sekalian akan disusuli".

transliteration: Fa arsala Fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen

translations.en.sahih: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
translations.en.pickthall: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,
translations.en.yusufali: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to (all) the Cities,
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Fir'aun mengirimkan orang yang mengumpulkan (tentaranya) ke kota-kota.

transliteration: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon

translations.en.sahih: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
translations.en.pickthall: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,
translations.en.yusufali: (Saying): "These (Israelites) are but a small band,
translations.id.indonesian: (Fir'aun berkata): "Sesungguhnya mereka (Bani Israil) benar-benar golongan kecil,

transliteration: Wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, they are enraging us,
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! they are offenders against us.
translations.en.yusufali: "And they are raging furiously against us;
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya mereka membuat hal-hal yang menimbulkan amarah kita,

transliteration: Wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! we are a ready host.
translations.en.yusufali: "But we are a multitude amply fore-warned."
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya kita benar-benar golongan yang selalu berjaga-jaga".

transliteration: Fa akhrajnaahum min Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.en.sahih: So We removed them from gardens and springs
translations.en.pickthall: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,
translations.en.yusufali: So We expelled them from gardens, springs,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami keluarkan Fir'aun dan kaumnya dari taman-taman dan mata air,

transliteration: Wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem

translations.en.sahih: And treasures and honorable station -
translations.en.pickthall: And treasures and a fair estate.
translations.en.yusufali: Treasures, and every kind of honourable position;
translations.id.indonesian: dan (dari) perbendaharaan dan kedudukan yang mulia,

transliteration: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.en.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things.
translations.id.indonesian: demikianlah halnya dan Kami anugerahkan semuanya (itu) kepada Bani Israil.

transliteration: Fa atba'oohum mushriqeen

translations.en.sahih: So they pursued them at sunrise.
translations.en.pickthall: And they overtook them at sunrise.
translations.en.yusufali: So they pursued them at sunrise.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Fir'aun dan bala tentaranya dapat menyusuli mereka di waktu matahari terbit.

arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
transliteration: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon

translations.en.sahih: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
translations.en.pickthall: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.
translations.en.yusufali: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka setelah kedua golongan itu saling melihat, berkatalah pengikut-pengikut Musa: "Sesungguhnya kita benar-benar akan tersusul".

arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
transliteration: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa yahdeen

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
translations.en.yusufali: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me!"
translations.id.indonesian: Musa menjawab: "Sekali-kali tidak akan tersusul; sesungguhnya Tuhanku besertaku, kelak Dia akan memberi petunjuk kepadaku".

arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Fa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.
translations.en.yusufali: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Kami wahyukan kepada Musa: "Pukullah lautan itu dengan tongkatmu". Maka terbelahlah lautan itu dan tiap-tiap belahan adalah seperti gunung yang besar.

transliteration: Wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen

translations.en.sahih: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
translations.en.pickthall: Then brought We near the others to that place.
translations.en.yusufali: And We made the other party approach thither.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan di sanalah Kami dekatkan golongan yang lain.

transliteration: Wa anjainaa Moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
translations.en.pickthall: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;
translations.en.yusufali: We delivered Moses and all who were with him;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami selamatkan Musa dan orang-orang yang besertanya semuanya.

transliteration: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen

translations.en.sahih: Then We drowned the others.
translations.en.pickthall: And We drowned the others.
translations.en.yusufali: But We drowned the others.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tenggelamkan golongan yang lain itu.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar merupakan suatu tanda yang besar (mukjizat) dan tetapi adalah kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

transliteration: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a Ibraaheem

translations.en.sahih: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
translations.en.pickthall: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:
translations.en.yusufali: And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham's story.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bacakanlah kepada mereka kisah Ibrahim.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon

translations.en.sahih: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
translations.en.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye?"
translations.id.indonesian: Ketika ia berkata kepada bapaknya dan kaumnya: "Apakah yang kamu sembah?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kami menyembah berhala-berhala dan kami senantiasa tekun menyembahnya".

transliteration: Qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata Ibrahim: "Apakah berhala-berhala itu mendengar (doa)mu sewaktu kamu berdoa (kepadanya)?,

transliteration: Aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon

translations.en.sahih: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
translations.en.pickthall: Or do they benefit or harm you?
translations.en.yusufali: "Or do you good or harm?"
translations.id.indonesian: atau (dapatkah) mereka memberi manfaat kepadamu atau memberi mudharat?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
transliteration: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "(Bukan karena itu) sebenarnya kami mendapati nenek moyang kami berbuat demikian".

transliteration: Qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
translations.en.pickthall: He said: See now that which ye worship,
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping,-
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim berkata: "Maka apakah kamu telah memperhatikan apa yang selalu kamu sembah,

transliteration: Antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon

translations.en.sahih: You and your ancient forefathers?
translations.en.pickthall: Ye and your forefathers!
translations.en.yusufali: "Ye and your fathers before you?-
translations.id.indonesian: kamu dan nenek moyang kamu yang dahulu?,

arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa Rabbal 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,
translations.en.yusufali: "For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds;
translations.id.indonesian: karena sesungguhnya apa yang kamu sembah itu adalah musuhku, kecuali Tuhan Semesta Alam,

transliteration: Allazee khalaqanee fa Huwa yahdeen

translations.en.sahih: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
translations.en.pickthall: Who created me, and He doth guide me,
translations.en.yusufali: "Who created me, and it is He Who guides me;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu Tuhan) Yang telah menciptakan aku, maka Dialah yang menunjuki aku,

transliteration: Wallazee Huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
translations.en.pickthall: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.
translations.en.yusufali: "Who gives me food and drink,
translations.id.indonesian: dan Tuhanku, Yang Dia memberi makan dan minum kepadaku,

transliteration: Wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen

translations.en.sahih: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
translations.en.pickthall: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,
translations.en.yusufali: "And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me;
translations.id.indonesian: dan apabila aku sakit, Dialah Yang menyembuhkan aku,

transliteration: Wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen

translations.en.sahih: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
translations.en.pickthall: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),
translations.en.yusufali: "Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again);
translations.id.indonesian: dan Yang akan mematikan aku, kemudian akan menghidupkan aku (kembali),

arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee Yawmad Deen

translations.en.sahih: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
translations.en.pickthall: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.
translations.en.yusufali: "And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Yang amat kuinginkan akan mengampuni kesalahanku pada hari kiamat".

arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen

translations.en.sahih: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: "O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous;
translations.id.indonesian: (Ibrahim berdoa): "Ya Tuhanku, berikanlah kepadaku hikmah dan masukkanlah aku ke dalam golongan orang-orang yang saleh,

arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
transliteration: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen

translations.en.sahih: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
translations.en.pickthall: And give unto me a good report in later generations.
translations.en.yusufali: "Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations);
translations.id.indonesian: dan jadikanlah aku buah tutur yang baik bagi orang-orang (yang datang) kemudian,

transliteration: Waj'alnee minw warasati Jannnatin Na'eem

translations.en.sahih: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
translations.en.pickthall: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,
translations.en.yusufali: "Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;
translations.id.indonesian: dan jadikanlah aku termasuk orang-orang yang mempusakai surga yang penuh kenikmatan,

arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
transliteration: Waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen

translations.en.sahih: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
translations.en.pickthall: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.
translations.en.yusufali: "Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray;
translations.id.indonesian: dan ampunilah bapakku, karena sesungguhnya ia adalah termasuk golongan orang-orang yang sesat,

transliteration: Wa laa tukhzinee Yawma yub'asoon

translations.en.sahih: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
translations.en.pickthall: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,
translations.en.yusufali: "And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan janganlah Engkau hinakan aku pada hari mereka dibangkitkan,

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
transliteration: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon

translations.en.sahih: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
translations.en.pickthall: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)
translations.en.yusufali: "The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) di hari harta dan anak-anak laki-laki tidak berguna,

arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem

translations.en.sahih: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
translations.en.pickthall: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.
translations.en.yusufali: "But only he (will prosper) that brings to Allah a sound heart;
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali orang-orang yang menghadap Allah dengan hati yang bersih,

transliteration: Wa uzlifatil Jannatu lilmuttaqeen

translations.en.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).
translations.en.yusufali: "To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near,
translations.id.indonesian: dan (di hari itu) didekatkanlah surga kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa,

transliteration: Wa burrizatil Jaheemu lilghaaween

translations.en.sahih: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
translations.en.pickthall: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.
translations.en.yusufali: "And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view;
translations.id.indonesian: dan diperlihatkan dengan jelas neraka Jahim kepada orang-orang yang sesat",

arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
transliteration: Wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon

translations.en.sahih: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
translations.en.pickthall: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship
translations.en.yusufali: "And it shall be said to them: 'Where are the (gods) ye worshipped-
translations.id.indonesian: dan dikatakan kepada mereka: "Dimanakah berhala-berhala yang dahulu kamu selalu menyembah(nya)

arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
transliteration: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon

translations.en.sahih: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
translations.en.pickthall: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?
translations.en.yusufali: "'Besides Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?'
translations.id.indonesian: selain dari Allah? Dapatkah mereka menolong kamu atau menolong diri mereka sendiri?"

transliteration: Fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon

translations.en.sahih: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
translations.en.pickthall: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
translations.en.yusufali: "Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka (sembahan-sembahan itu) dijungkirkan ke dalam neraka bersama-sama orang-orang yang sesat,

transliteration: Wa junoodu Ibleesa ajma'oon

translations.en.sahih: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
translations.en.pickthall: And the hosts of Iblis, together.
translations.en.yusufali: "And the whole hosts of Iblis together.
translations.id.indonesian: dan bala tentara iblis semuanya.

transliteration: Qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon

translations.en.sahih: They will say while they dispute therein,
translations.en.pickthall: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:
translations.en.yusufali: "They will say there in their mutual bickerings:
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata sedang mereka bertengkar di dalam neraka:

arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
translations.en.pickthall: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
translations.en.yusufali: "'By Allah, we were truly in an error manifest,
translations.id.indonesian: "demi Allah: sungguh kita dahulu (di dunia) dalam kesesatan yang nyata,

transliteration: Iz nusawweekum bi Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.en.yusufali: "'When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds;
translations.id.indonesian: karena kita mempersamakan kamu dengan Tuhan semesta alam".

transliteration: Wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon

translations.en.sahih: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: It was but the guilty who misled us.
translations.en.yusufali: "'And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tiadalah yang menyesatkan kami kecuali orang-orang yang berdosa.

transliteration: Famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een

translations.en.sahih: So now we have no intercessors
translations.en.pickthall: Now we have no intercessors
translations.en.yusufali: "'Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us),
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kami tidak mempunyai pemberi syafa'at seorangpun,

transliteration: Wa laa sadeeqin hameem

translations.en.sahih: And not a devoted friend.
translations.en.pickthall: Nor any loving friend.
translations.en.yusufali: "'Nor a single friend to feel (for us).
translations.id.indonesian: dan tidak pula mempunyai teman yang akrab,

arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
translations.en.pickthall: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
translations.en.yusufali: "'Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe!'"
translations.id.indonesian: maka sekiranya kita dapat kembali sekali lagi (ke dunia) niscaya kami menjadi orang-orang yang beriman".

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah), tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

transliteration: Kazzabat qawmu Noohinil Mursaleen

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied the messengers
translations.en.pickthall: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
translations.en.yusufali: The people of Noah rejected the messengers.
translations.id.indonesian: Kaum Nuh telah mendustakan para rasul.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
transliteration: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon

translations.en.sahih: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.pickthall: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
translations.id.indonesian: Ketika saudara mereka (Nuh) berkata kepada mereka: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?

transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
translations.en.yusufali: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya aku adalah seorang rasul kepercayaan (yang diutus) kepadamu,

transliteration: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
translations.en.yusufali: "So fear Allah, and obey me.
translations.id.indonesian: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku.

arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.en.yusufali: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku sekali-kali tidak minta upah kepadamu atas ajakan-ajakan itu; upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Tuhan semesta alam.

transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me."
translations.en.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
translations.en.yusufali: "So fear Allah, and obey me."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku".

transliteration: Qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Apakah kami akan beriman kepadamu, padahal yang mengikuti kamu ialah orang-orang yang hina?".

arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
translations.en.pickthall: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do?
translations.id.indonesian: Nuh menjawab: "Bagaimana aku mengetahui apa yang telah mereka kerjakan?

arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
transliteration: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon

translations.en.sahih: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;
translations.en.yusufali: "Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand.
translations.id.indonesian: Perhitungan (amal perbuatan) mereka tidak lain hanyalah kepada Tuhanku, kalau kamu menyadari.

transliteration: Wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
translations.en.pickthall: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.
translations.en.yusufali: "I am not one to drive away those who believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku sekali-kali tidak akan mengusir orang-orang yang beriman.

transliteration: In ana illaa nazeerum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: I am only a clear warner."
translations.en.pickthall: I am only a plain warner.
translations.en.yusufali: "I am sent only to warn plainly in public."
translations.id.indonesian: Aku (ini) tidak lain melainkan pemberi peringatan yang menjelaskan".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Sungguh jika kamu tidak (mau) berhenti hai Nuh, niscaya benar-benar kamu akan termasuk orang-orang yang dirajam".

transliteration: Qaala Rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me.
translations.id.indonesian: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya kaumku telah mendustakan aku;

arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
translations.en.yusufali: "Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me."
translations.id.indonesian: maka itu adakanlah suatu keputusan antaraku dan antara mereka, dan selamatkanlah aku dan orang-orang yang mukmin besertaku".

arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
transliteration: Fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon

translations.en.sahih: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
translations.en.pickthall: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
translations.en.yusufali: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami selamatkan Nuh dan orang-orang yang besertanya di dalam kapal yang penuh muatan.

transliteration: Summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen

translations.en.sahih: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
translations.en.pickthall: Then afterward We drowned the others.
translations.en.yusufali: Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind.

translations.id.indonesian: Dan bertakwalah kepada Allah yang telah menganugerahkan kepadamu apa yang kamu ketahui.

translations.en.sahih: And gardens and springs.

translations.id.indonesian: dan kebun-kebun dan mata air,

transliteration: Innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem

translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Adalah sama saja bagi kami, apakah kamu memberi nasehat atau tidak memberi nasehat,

translations.en.pickthall: This is but a fable of the men of old,
