transliteration: Wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon

translations.en.sahih: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
translations.en.pickthall: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.
translations.en.yusufali: "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your mates? Nay, ye are a people transgressing (all limits)!"
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu tinggalkan isteri-isteri yang dijadikan oleh Tuhanmu untukmu, bahkan kamu adalah orang-orang yang melampaui batas".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
transliteration: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "If thou desist not, O Lut! thou wilt assuredly be cast out!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Hai Luth, sesungguhnya jika kamu tidak berhenti, benar-benar kamu termasuk orang-orang yang diusir"

transliteration: Qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
translations.en.pickthall: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "I do detest your doings."
translations.id.indonesian: Luth berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku sangat benci kepada perbuatanmu".

transliteration: Rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon

translations.en.sahih: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
translations.en.pickthall: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.
translations.en.yusufali: "O my Lord! deliver me and my family from such things as they do!"
translations.id.indonesian: (Luth berdoa): "Ya Tuhanku selamatkanlah aku beserta keluargaku dari (akibat) perbuatan yang mereka kerjakan".

transliteration: Fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een

translations.en.sahih: So We saved him and his family, all,
translations.en.pickthall: So We saved him and his household, every one,
translations.en.yusufali: So We delivered him and his family,- all
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Kami selamatkan ia beserta keluarganya semua,

transliteration: Illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen

translations.en.sahih: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
translations.en.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
translations.en.yusufali: Except an old woman who lingered behind.
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali seorang perempuan tua (isterinya), yang termasuk dalam golongan yang tinggal.

transliteration: Summa dammarnal aa khareen

translations.en.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
translations.en.pickthall: Then afterward We destroyed the others.
translations.en.yusufali: But the rest We destroyed utterly.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami binasakan yang lain.

arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
transliteration: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen

translations.en.sahih: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
translations.en.pickthall: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
translations.en.yusufali: We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami hujani mereka dengan hujan (batu) maka amat jeleklah hujan yang menimpa orang-orang yang telah diberi peringatan itu.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesunguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat bukti-bukti yang nyata. Dan adalah kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

transliteration: Kazzaba As haabul Aykatil mursaleen

translations.en.sahih: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
translations.en.pickthall: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),
translations.en.yusufali: The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers.
translations.id.indonesian: Penduduk Aikah telah mendustakan rasul-rasul;

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
transliteration: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon

translations.en.sahih: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.pickthall: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
translations.id.indonesian: ketika Syu'aib berkata kepada mereka: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?,

transliteration: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
translations.en.yusufali: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya aku adalah seorang rasul kepercayaan (yang diutus) kepadamu.

transliteration: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
translations.en.yusufali: "So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.id.indonesian: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku;

arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
transliteration: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.en.yusufali: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.id.indonesian: dan aku sekali-kali tidak minta upah kepadamu atas ajakan itu; upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Tuhan semesta alam.

arabic: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
transliteration: Awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen

translations.en.sahih: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
translations.en.pickthall: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).
translations.en.yusufali: "Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud).
translations.id.indonesian: Sempurnakanlah takaran dan janganlah kamu termasuk orang-orang yang merugikan;

transliteration: Wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: And weigh with an even balance.
translations.en.pickthall: And weigh with the true balance.
translations.en.yusufali: "And weigh with scales true and upright.
translations.id.indonesian: dan timbanglah dengan timbangan yang lurus.

arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
transliteration: Wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen

translations.en.sahih: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
translations.en.pickthall: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
translations.en.yusufali: "And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan janganlah kamu merugikan manusia pada hak-haknya dan janganlah kamu merajalela di muka bumi dengan membuat kerusakan;

transliteration: Wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
translations.en.pickthall: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.
translations.en.yusufali: "And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)"
translations.id.indonesian: dan bertakwalah kepada Allah yang telah menciptakan kamu dan umat-umat yang dahulu".

transliteration: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu adalah salah seorang dari orang-orang yang kena sihir,

arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
transliteration: Wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen

translations.en.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.
translations.en.yusufali: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar!
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu tidak lain melainkan seorang manusia seperti kami, dan sesungguhnya kami yakin bahwa kamu benar-benar termasuk orang-orang yang berdusta.

arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
translations.en.pickthall: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.
translations.en.yusufali: "Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka jatuhkanlah atas kami gumpalan dari langit, jika kamu termasuk orang-orang yang benar.

transliteration: Qaala Rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do."
translations.id.indonesian: Syu'aib berkata: "Tuhanku lebih mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan".

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem

translations.en.sahih: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
translations.en.pickthall: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
translations.en.yusufali: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian mereka mendustakan Syu'aib, lalu mereka ditimpa azab pada hari mereka dinaungi awan. Sesungguhnya azab itu adalah azab hari yang besar.

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kekuasaan Allah), tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

transliteration: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

transliteration: Wa innahoo latanzeelu Rabbil 'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran ini benar-benar diturunkan oleh Tuhan semesta alam,

transliteration: Nazala bihir Roohul Ameen

translations.en.sahih: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
translations.en.pickthall: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
translations.en.yusufali: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-
translations.id.indonesian: dia dibawa turun oleh Ar-Ruh Al-Amin (Jibril),

transliteration: 'Alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen

translations.en.sahih: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
translations.en.pickthall: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
translations.en.yusufali: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.
translations.id.indonesian: ke dalam hatimu (Muhammad) agar kamu menjadi salah seorang di antara orang-orang yang memberi peringatan,

transliteration: Bilisaanin 'Arabiyyim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: In a clear Arabic language.
translations.en.pickthall: In plain Arabic speech.
translations.en.yusufali: In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.
translations.id.indonesian: dengan bahasa Arab yang jelas.

transliteration: Wa innahoo lafee Zuburil awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
translations.en.yusufali: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar (tersebut) dalam Kitab-kitab orang yang dahulu.

arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
transliteration: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel

translations.en.sahih: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
translations.en.pickthall: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
translations.en.yusufali: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apakah tidak cukup menjadi bukti bagi mereka, bahwa para ulama Bani Israil mengetahuinya?

transliteration: Wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen

translations.en.sahih: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
translations.en.pickthall: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
translations.en.yusufali: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kalau Al Quran itu Kami turunkan kepada salah seorang dari golongan bukan Arab,

arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
translations.en.pickthall: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
translations.en.yusufali: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
translations.id.indonesian: lalu ia membacakannya kepada mereka (orang-orang kafir); niscaya mereka tidak akan beriman kepadanya.

transliteration: Kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen

translations.en.sahih: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.
translations.id.indonesian: Demikianlah Kami masukkan Al Quran ke dalam hati orang-orang yang durhaka.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
transliteration: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem

translations.en.sahih: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
translations.en.yusufali: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tidak beriman kepadanya, hingga mereka melihat azab yang pedih,

transliteration: Fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

translations.en.sahih: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
translations.en.pickthall: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
translations.en.yusufali: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
translations.id.indonesian: maka datanglah azab kepada mereka dengan mendadak, sedang mereka tidak menyadarinya,

transliteration: Fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon

translations.en.sahih: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
translations.en.pickthall: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
translations.en.yusufali: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"
translations.id.indonesian: lalu mereka berkata: "Apakah kami dapat diberi tangguh?"

transliteration: Aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon

translations.en.sahih: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
translations.en.pickthall: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
translations.en.yusufali: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah mereka meminta supaya disegerakan azab Kami?

transliteration: Aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen

translations.en.sahih: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bagaimana pendapatmu jika Kami berikan kepada mereka kenikmatan hidup bertahun-tahun,

transliteration: Summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon

translations.en.sahih: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
translations.en.pickthall: And then cometh that which they were promised,
translations.en.yusufali: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian datang kepada mereka azab yang telah diancamkan kepada mereka,

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
transliteration: Maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon

translations.en.sahih: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
translations.en.pickthall: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
translations.en.yusufali: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!
translations.id.indonesian: niscaya tidak berguna bagi mereka apa yang mereka selalu menikmatinya.

arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon

translations.en.sahih: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
translations.en.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
translations.en.yusufali: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tidak membinasakan sesuatu negeripun, melainkan sesudah ada baginya orang-orang yang memberi peringatan;

transliteration: Zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
translations.en.pickthall: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
translations.en.yusufali: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.
translations.id.indonesian: untuk menjadi peringatan. Dan Kami sekali-kali tidak berlaku zalim.

transliteration: Wa maa tanazzalat bihish Shayaateen

translations.en.sahih: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
translations.en.pickthall: The devils did not bring it down.
translations.en.yusufali: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Al Quran itu bukanlah dibawa turun oleh syaitan-syaitan.

transliteration: Wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon

translations.en.sahih: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
translations.en.pickthall: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
translations.en.yusufali: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tidaklah patut mereka membawa turun Al Quran itu, dan merekapun tidak akan kuasa.

transliteration: Innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
translations.en.yusufali: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar dijauhkan daripada mendengar Al Quran itu.

arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
transliteration: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen

translations.en.sahih: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
translations.en.yusufali: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka janganlah kamu menyeru (menyembah) tuhan yang lain di samping Allah, yang menyebabkan kamu termasuk orang-orang yang diazab.

transliteration: Wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen

translations.en.sahih: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
translations.en.pickthall: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
translations.en.yusufali: And admonish thy nearest kinsmen,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berilah peringatan kepada kerabat-kerabatmu yang terdekat,

arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
translations.en.pickthall: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
translations.en.yusufali: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.
translations.id.indonesian: dan rendahkanlah dirimu terhadap orang-orang yang mengikutimu, yaitu orang-orang yang beriman.

arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
translations.en.pickthall: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
translations.en.yusufali: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
translations.id.indonesian: Jika mereka mendurhakaimu maka katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku tidak bertanggung jawab terhadap apa yang kamu kerjakan";

transliteration: Wa tawakkal alal 'Azeezir Raheem

translations.en.sahih: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
translations.en.pickthall: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bertawakkallah kepada (Allah) Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang,

transliteration: Allazee yaraaka heena taqoom

translations.en.sahih: Who sees you when you arise
translations.en.pickthall: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
translations.en.yusufali: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),
translations.id.indonesian: Yang melihat kamu ketika kamu berdiri (untuk sembahyang),

transliteration: Wa taqallubaka fis saajideen

translations.en.sahih: And your movement among those who prostrate.
translations.en.pickthall: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
translations.en.yusufali: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves,
translations.id.indonesian: dan (melihat pula) perubahan gerak badanmu di antara orang-orang yang sujud.

transliteration: Innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
translations.en.yusufali: For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Dia adalah Yang Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui.

arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
transliteration: Hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush Shayaateen

translations.en.sahih: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
translations.en.pickthall: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
translations.en.yusufali: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah akan Aku beritakan kepadamu, kepada siapa syaitan-syaitan itu turun?

transliteration: Tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem

translations.en.sahih: They descend upon every sinful liar.
translations.en.pickthall: They descend on every sinful, false one.
translations.en.yusufali: They descend on every lying, wicked person,
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka turun kepada tiap-tiap pendusta lagi yang banyak dosa,

transliteration: Yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon

translations.en.sahih: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
translations.en.pickthall: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
translations.en.yusufali: (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka menghadapkan pendengaran (kepada syaitan) itu, dan kebanyakan mereka adalah orang-orang pendusta.

transliteration: Washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon

translations.en.sahih: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
translations.en.pickthall: As for poets, the erring follow them.
translations.en.yusufali: And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan penyair-penyair itu diikuti oleh orang-orang yang sesat.

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
transliteration: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon

translations.en.sahih: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
translations.en.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
translations.en.yusufali: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley?-
translations.id.indonesian: Tidakkah kamu melihat bahwasanya mereka mengembara di tiap-tiap lembah,

transliteration: Wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon

translations.en.sahih: And that they say what they do not do? -
translations.en.pickthall: And how they say that which they do not?
translations.en.yusufali: And that they say what they practise not?-
translations.id.indonesian: dan bahwasanya mereka suka mengatakan apa yang mereka sendiri tidak mengerjakan(nya)?

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon

translations.en.sahih: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
translations.en.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
translations.en.yusufali: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take!
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali orang-orang (penyair-penyair) yang beriman dan beramal saleh dan banyak menyebut Allah dan mendapat kemenangan sesudah menderita kezaliman. Dan orang-orang yang zalim itu kelak akan mengetahui ke tempat mana mereka akan kembali.
